holds.name: Land Section
holds.comments: Land Section“Per Section 86-46 of the Citrus County Code of Ordinances, the County has implemented procedures for collecting an assessment prior to the issuance of the Certificate of Occupancy for: • new single-family residences, • new mobile homes, • new non-residential buildings, and • may also include any modifications to the size/impervious area of a structure or property within the County. Please submit a request for Interim Assessment Fees to be applied on a permit when scheduling Final Inspections, prior to your Certificate of Occupancy being issued to Land-NoReply@citrusbocc.com. Be sure to include the complete permit number, site address and contact information so we may better assist you. Thank you.Applied

holds.name: Termite Treatment Certificate
holds.comments: Termite Treatment CertificatePlease provide a Final Termite Treatment Certificate. Upload a copy of this document to your online account under the document type ‘Termite Certificate’. **Please note that if a termite bait system has been used for termite treatment compliance a copy of the contract/agreement for the installation, monitoring and maintenance is required. Both documents may be uploaded into ‘Termite Treatment Certificate’.** If you do not see this document type, or have further questions regarding this condition or document, please contact planreview@citrusbocc.com Please do not upload this under any other incorrect document type.Applied
